about: A turn of the agent preset kingdom-brief-check, recorded for the portal chat route (src/Portal/Agent/README.md). Only the text is recorded: every {placeholder} is filled from the live tool results, so the answer shows what the signed-in portal user may view.

unknownQuestion.text: This demo answers its recorded questions only. Try: {questions}

questions: Does my latest Thunder Loop revision meet the brief?
Does the latest revision meet the brief?
Check my latest revision against the brief

steps.text: I read the Thunder Loop brief: no point of the track may be higher than {briefLimitM} m above the station.
I can't see any revision of the design that you may view, so there is nothing to check yet.
You may view {revisionCount} revisions of the design: {revisionList}.
Revision {latest.revision} reaches {latest.maxHeightM} m, {overLimitM} m above the brief's limit, and the Storm Valley building permit allows no more. I have prepared a Supplier note on it for you:

steps.propose: Revision {latest.revision} is {latest.maxHeightM} m high; the brief allows at most {briefLimitM} m (Storm Valley building permit). Please bring the lift hill back down before the park reviews this revision.

steps.text: Confirm it to add the note to revision {latest.revision}; nothing is written before you do.
Revision {latest.revision} stays within the limit at {latest.maxHeightM} m, so there is nothing to note.
